_notes: FishBrain parameters (P2.3). Coordinates are scene pixels of the fish anchor (the rig mirror_center), times in seconds, speeds in px/s. The lane and ellipses are the BrainDemoScene layout; ReefTank replaces them with its lane rects and config/scene.json population.ellipses (P2.7). Ellipse radii are padded for the anchor point, not the 240x113 body, so a body can still overlap an ellipse edge. pitch tips each Fish nose along its path (components/lib/brain.brs brainPitchTarget): up to cruiseDeg at speedLo px/s and below, ramping to maxDeg at speedHi (darts), closing follow of the gap per tick. nodeLogSeconds > 0 logs the scene node count every that many seconds of scene time (preview aid; 0 disables).
